steps.title: Validate and select only uninjected adapters
body: Environment overrides .env. Only sqlite is a runtime store. Unknown names or missing selected Mongo credentials fail startup without printing values. Explicit injection takes precedence.

steps.title: Provider-neutral initialization and failures
body: Initialize and readiness belong to CardStorePort. SQLite translates expected failures to StorageUnavailable; HTTP preserves liveness, sanitized 503 and distinct 409.

steps.title: Only selected sink receives events
body: Mongo keeps its async queue and fallback. Stdout writes allowlisted JSON to API stdout; none drops events. Telemetry never determines readiness.

diagrams.title: 10 / Policy-driven agentic orchestration with RAG and LangGraph state
diagrams.subtitle: Dynamic orchestration evaluating versioned markdown policies against verified facts to steer specialist delegation, interactive questions, and resilient execution.

steps.title: Interpret customer intent and retrieve verified facts
body: Supervisor inspects inbound user message, extracts domain entities, and queries authoritative banking APIs for verified account and card facts.

steps.title: Local RAG policy retrieval (hybrid mandatory + semantic)
body: Deterministic mandatory retrieval ensures zero policy omissions for regulated operations, combined with local dense vector search over indexed markdown sections.

steps.title: Deterministic policy evaluation and version pinning
body: Policy rules evaluate against facts, pin active policy versions in LangGraph state, and formulate interactive questions or specialist delegation routes.

steps.title: Multi-agent specialist execution with human confirmation
body: LangGraph orchestrates handoffs to FinCrime or Cards agents, gates mutations behind human confirmation, and resumes subsequent planned intents on verified success.
